_comment: Synthetic (NDA-clean) fill config for gen_fixtures.py output. Replace layer numbers, per-layer target/max density and space/width with the foundry CMP values for a real run; the numbers here are generic placeholders. NOTE 'fill_datatype': leave null so the dummy fill lands on the metal's OWN datatype — then it counts toward the CMP density measurement and is checked by the spacing/width DRC deck (both key on the drawing layer). Only set a separate fill datatype if your density rule and DRC deck also include that datatype.
